---
title: "Resources"
description: "Datasets and research hubs on populism."
---

A short, curated list. Each link goes to the project's own site.

## Datasets

[Global Populism Database](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/LFTQEZ)
: How populist the speeches of presidents and prime ministers are, across countries and terms of office, coded by hand. Hosted on Harvard Dataverse.

[The PopuList](https://popu-list.org)
: Populist, far-left and far-right parties in Europe since 1989, classified with the help of country experts.

[V-Party](https://www.v-dem.net/data/v-party-dataset/)
: The V-Dem Institute's dataset on the policy positions and organisation of political parties across the world.

[Chapel Hill Expert Survey (CHES)](https://www.chesdata.eu)
: Expert estimates of where national parties in Europe stand on European integration, ideology and policy issues, in waves since 1999.

## Other hubs

[European Center for Populism Studies (ECPS)](https://www.populismstudies.org)
: An independent centre in Brussels for research on and analysis of populism.

[Illiberalism Studies Hub](https://hub.illiberalism.org/)
: A database of academic articles on illiberalism, kept by the Illiberalism Studies Program at George Washington University.

[Team Populism](https://populism.byu.edu)
: A network of scholars who study the causes and consequences of populism. Its site hosts datasets and papers.

[POPULISMUS](https://populismus.gr)
: An observatory of populist discourse at the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki.
